pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; pyramiding only authorized when active trade unrealized profit exceeds +$5.00 with stop loss locked in profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Block all new entry signals between 19:30 UTC and 22:00 UTC; mandate 15m ATR > 2.5 and volume > 1.2x 20-period SMA prior to authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger partial harvest (50%) at +$5.00 floating gain, trail remaining 50% via Sentinel Peak Harvest targeting $15.00-$30.00 runs.
